Easy Mango Crumble

This is a perfect pudding that you will love. And it couldn't be easier. Think juicy, golden mango topped with a crisp, buttery oat crumble, baked until golden and bubbling.

Spiced Chickpea & Roasted Veg Flatbreads

These warm flatbreads are topped with creamy hummus, smoky roasted vegetables and crispy chickpeas. They make the perfect quick lunch or easy dinner for all.

See all our recipes

A growing community.

Over 67,000 tonnes of fruit and veg rescued so far – and counting.

Since Oddbox started, we’ve helped over 110 growers find a home for their unloved leeks and perfectly-imperfect pears, in the UK and further afield. (Don’t worry – we have a no-air-miles policy.) We’re also fighting waste in other ways through our Market, where we’ve rescued over 26,000 items at risk of going to waste.

Join us

Fight waste

As much as 2.5 billion tonnes of food are wasted globally each year – a major contributor to the climate crisis. Something has to change.

Celebrate taste

Cooking should be creative, splatty and joyful. With new recipes every week, we’re celebrating the fresh and seasonal in all shapes and forms.

Make food fair

In a topsy-turvy food system, we’re doing things differently. No ‘cosmetic’ rules. No pointless packaging. And fair prices for growers – always.

content.question_to_explore: What income does the investment entity retain from Fruit & Veg Boxes, and does it cover attributable variable service costs?

content.proposed_work: We propose a contribution reconciliation and customer analysis for Fruit & Veg Boxes. We request the accounting/service-cost records: entity chart, service/fee-sharing agreements, redacted invoices, credit notes, revenue ledger, collection and partner-settlement statements, supplier invoices, direct service/support cost records, and staff-time allocations. The concrete deliverable is a source-linked contribution profit table and a source-linked cohort rate table. This supports the commercial decision to investigate loss-making services, choose pricing or delivery-cost work, and select the next activation or retention investigation before an expansion recommendation. We request redacted account-event and customer/cohort exports for Fruit & Veg Boxes, including stable customer keys, event types, timestamps, plan details, completion/cancellation status, registration dates, eligibility flags, and data cutoffs, with anonymized customer IDs and dates.
content.invitation: Invite a conversation with one question: Are you available to discuss the data requirements and timeline for this analysis?

content.question: What income does the investment entity retain from Fruit & Veg Boxes, and does it cover attributable variable service costs?

analysis_plan.question: What income does the investment entity retain from Fruit & Veg Boxes, and does it cover attributable variable service costs?

left.name: Recognized service revenue after partner charges, if applicable
left.record_needed: Entity chart and service/fee-sharing agreements; redacted invoices, credit notes, revenue ledger, collection and partner-settlement statements. Include entity, plan, account key, month, currency, refunds and taxes. Reconcile recognition and gross/net presentation; identify any partner charges already deducted and normalize them exactly once. Exclude customer principal, assets and pass-through taxes from revenue.
left.entity: Investment target, legal identity and contracting entities to confirm
left.population: Eligible service accounts, separated by plan and operating month

right.name: Attributable variable service costs excluding partner charges already deducted
right.record_needed: Supplier invoices, direct service/support cost records and staff-time allocations for the same entity, plans, accounts and months.
